faqSection.description: Find answers to common questions about our services, appointments, treatments and patient care. If you have any other questions, feel free to contact us.

faqs.question: How do I book an appointment ?
faqs.answer: You can book an appointment through our website, by calling our helpline, or by visiting the clinic directly. Our team will help you choose the right doctor and convenient time slot for your visit.

faqs.question: What types of treatments do you offer ?
faqs.answer: We offer general medicine, pediatrics, cardiology, orthopedic care, diagnostics, preventive health checkups, and specialized surgical consultations.

faqs.question: Do you accept health insurance ?
faqs.answer: Yes, we accept major health insurance providers and cashless mediclaim policies. Contact our help desk for the complete list of empanelled TPAs.

faqs.question: How can I reschedule or cancel my appointment ?
faqs.answer: You can easily reschedule or cancel your appointment at least 4 hours in advance via our website portal or by calling our customer care number.

faqs.question: Are online consultations available ?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide high-definition video consultations with top specialists for follow-ups and routine inquiries from the comfort of your home.
